methodology_note: Numerator: AISHE 2021-22 enrolment. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 population (15-19 + 20-24) x 0.6 as an 18-23 proxy, held fixed across rounds (Census 2021 deferred). Published national GER 2021-22 approx 28% (MoSPI projected denominator); our 2011-denominator computation sits a few pp above. The Muslim-vs-national gap is the story and is robust to the denominator. Total enrolment 43,268,181 from the AISHE 2021-22 Report p29 prose. Muslim enrolment is the All-India 'Muslim Minority' Table 15 total (the official aggregate, not a sum of state rows). Muslim numerator: 2,108,033; Muslim 18-23 proxy: 21,445,159.

AISHE groups every non-Muslim minority into one 'Other Minority Community' (Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) and never splits them, so this is the finest community comparison the source allows. Numerator: All-India Other Minority enrolment (905,159) for 2021-22. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 (15-19 + 20-24) x 0.6, summed over Christian, Sikh, Buddhist and Jain (6,957,030).
